search_serper: search using serper.dev API with api_key, query, count, and optional filter_list to return SearchResult objects
create_search_result_objects: create SearchResult objects with link, title, and snippet fields from serper.dev organic search results
filter_search_results_by_domain: filter serper.dev search results by allowed domains using get_filtered_results and a filter list
sort_search_results_by_position: sort serper.dev organic search results by position field in ascending order before returning
limit_search_results_count: limit serper.dev search results to the specified count by slicing the sorted result list
